International non-proprietary name (INN): diphtheria, tetanus, acellular pertussis, inactivated poliomyelitis, hepatitis B (recombinant) and Haemophilus influenzae type b conjugate vaccine, adjuvanted
Active substance: purified diphtheria toxoid;purified tetanus toxoid;purified pertussis toxoid;purified pertussis filamentous haemagglutinin;hepatitis B surface antigen;Inactivated Type 1 Poliovirus (Mahoney);Inactivated Type 3 Poliovirus (Saukett);Haemophilus influenzae type b polysaccharide
Therapeutic indication: This combined vaccine is indicated for primary and booster vaccination of children against diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, hepatitis B caused by all known subtypes of viruses, poliomyelitis and invasive infections caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b.
